calibration.selection: A-only numerical stability fix; no B outcomes used

protocol.thresholds: Conservative 5 hourly alerts/100 hours on A validation; unchanged on B.
protocol.budget: Retrospective label-free within-cohort score ranking, SHA256 patient-hour tie-break; not a prospectively deployable threshold or tuning on B outcomes.
protocol.catch: At least one hourly alert in [inferred onset-12h, inferred onset); first-label-positive patients excluded because onset is left-censored.
protocol.false_alarm: An hourly alert outside the useful pre-onset window, including repeated late/post-onset alerts.
protocol.catches_per_100_alarms: Distinct caught patients / all hourly alerts x100; not hourly PPV.
protocol.warning: Median onset minus first useful alarm, conditional on a catch.
protocol.onset: First positive SepsisLabel hour + 6; inferred, not independently observed. First-hour positives are left-censored.
protocol.ci: 500 percentile bootstrap replicates resampling whole patients, fixed model/threshold/ranking; excludes model-training and threshold-selection uncertainty.
protocol.calibration: Platt scaling fitted on held-out A training patients; not refitted on B.

demo.selection: Default is a deliberately selected illustrative early-warning case; remaining patients are a seeded random sample. Not an evaluation cohort.

Wong.context: At the studied threshold, Epic's model missed 67% of sepsis cases; this is a separate study, not a head-to-head comparison.

TREWS.context: Provider confirmation within three hours was associated with lower adjusted mortality in an observational cohort; not a randomized causal estimate.
